explication: pdf-inspector classifies a PDF, extracts positioned text, analyzes layout, and produces Markdown; native entry points can optionally route only suspect pages through OCR. The principal flow is: caller submits bytes or a file, the core parses once, classification selects text/OCR behavior, extraction and layout produce structured content, and Markdown/result bindings return it. The tree and excerpts confirm the core and OCR orchestration; several lower-level call arrows are inferred only where module responsibilities and README behavior align.
